name: TMM deferred sell burn drains the TMM/USDT pair
summary: While freeTrade is off, TMM accumulates waitBurnTokenAmount from buys and, on the next sell into the pair, transfers that amount from the TMM/USDT pair to 0xdead and calls sync(). The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought TMM to grow the pending burn beyond the pair's balance, triggered two pair burns that left a reserve of 1 TMM-wei, and sold a small amount of TMM for almost all of the pair's USDT.

loss.notes: USDT reserve drop of the TMM/USDT pair in the exploit transaction. The reported $1.665m is the attacker's profit after flash-loan costs.

ageReset.description: Fifth and last upgradeTo before the exploit activated the exploited TMM implementation.

sources.note: Loss. getReserves() of pair 0xc36c718e7d0af055092e5274f92f6511820ca041 (token0 TMM, token1 USDT) at blocks 90651457/90651458: TMM 6947333139460646484001411839 -> 850000000000000001, USDT 1677164868298635384692298 -> 320913932 base units (18 decimals), a USDT drop of 1677164868298635063778366. Every USDT Transfer to or from the pair from its creation (block 85971745) to block 90800000 (27869 transactions) nets more than 10,000 USDT out of the pair only in source-1.

Root cause, anchor and age. Source-1 receipt (block 90651458, index 1): attacker contract 0x1c5e8d3501bbcae900e14d8720774d9ff6ec7203 buys TMM through PancakeRouter, then TMM Transfer logs 0x87 and 0x8a move 6820238188812069559145384304 and then 41596303727631819910000000 base units of TMM from the pair to 0xdead, each followed by Sync (log 0x8b reserve0 = 1); log 0x8d sells 0.85 TMM for the USDT reserve. Verified implementation source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, TMM, v0.8.24; SHA-256 of SourceCode 9c0bd16edd546ee069e4df7af0b41e2d3425957ff6574c30a802f3faa3e9431d): in _transfer, a transfer to the pair with freeTrade false and waitBurnTokenAmount > 0 executes super._transfer(pair, 0xdead, waitBurnTokenAmount) and IPair(pair).sync() with no bound against the pair balance. freeTrade() is false and waitBurnTokenAmount() grows from 83050100000000000000 at block 87658334 to 4758744622255100000000 at block 90651457. Age: Etherscan V2 getLogs for Upgraded on proxy 0x1d6f03b0b20b2ec05b37bf60f56af442ced66666 returns five events, the last source-3 (block 87658335, owner 0xd6f00d8ed0898442f75708eb181243119c8c6ba8) selecting the implementation; eth_getStorageAt of the EIP-1967 slot at block 90651457 returns it. The implementation (created in 0x513b931a0c943a6dd8a2fa58c6aa4d7d5f7cf1d6a13fd59a0bdb55a854de567b, block 87658236) has no code at block 87658235, and keccak256 of its runtime is the recorded hash at blocks 87658335 and 90651457. The only other owner transaction to the proxy after source-3 is renounceOwnership.
